label: context.reference
text: This is the bound capability contract for the Outlook Email Application at exact World interface world_mcp_microsoft_outlook_email. Installation proves only that the package owners are present; availability requires the real project EE policy, task connection requires the exact interface binding plus this artifact binding, and none of those facts proves a live remote server. Use its emitted catalogs for Outlook messages, threads, drafts, folders, attachments, and mailbox capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Treat mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates, and mcp.prompt_catalog artifacts emitted by world_mcp_microsoft_outlook_email as the current server evidence. To invoke a discovered tool, emit an ordinary artifact.send to world_mcp_microsoft_outlook_email with label mcp.operation.request and a payload whose operation is microsoft_outlook_email.call_tool and whose arguments carry the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use microsoft_outlook_email.read_resource, microsoft_outlook_email.get_prompt, and microsoft_outlook_email.complete only with exact catalog identifiers; use microsoft_outlook_email.status or microsoft_outlook_email.ping when liveness or negotiated capability matters. A sent request is not proof of a world effect: wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event, or refusal artifact and report failures honestly. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens, and refresh state remain private to the interface; carry only non-secret handles and status artifacts across Octopus boundaries.
